assessment: actual workflow/artifact/installer checks rather than an abstract publication promise
remaining: Local tests cannot establish every packaged platform or published asset. Protected validation and release checks remain required.
evidenceDecision: Real packaging/installer/release/CI tests exercise archive validation and dependency gates; actual platform/release workflows supply distribution evidence. Upstream-sync tests directly enumerate bounded repair/authority cases and reconstruct conflicting Git merges with exact ancestry and binary patches; hosted App eligibility, model quality and API execution remain platform evidence (docs/upstream-automation.md). Proposed installer-upgrade CI builds real native candidate archives and exercises latest-stable plugin installation, authenticated runtime/session migration and failed-checksum retention in isolated state. This direct platform evidence is more useful than a model of OS packaging; Older release combinations beyond the frozen previous release remain excluded (docs/release.md). OpenSpec notes source admission and public feature rendering use direct filesystem/Markdown/link regressions; Pages workflow checks cover build inputs and test wiring. Native OpenSpec owns agent discovery; no repository lookup remains. These static transformations introduce no ordering or recovery state, so direct build and policy checks are more useful than an additional model; synchronous OpenSpec batch archives use real Git and the pinned CLI to cover merge-date ordering, incomplete tasks, successful-prefix retention and restored conflict boundaries. Archive-helper fixtures cover reviewed preparation without automatic main publication; hosted execution and review remain platform evidence. The feature-map repair additionally checks the complete tracked-source baseline, deleted-source admission without weakening spec deletion policy, the real legacy archive baseline and visible empty-batch failures. Release waiting/failure/expiry transitions use an injected clock and exhaustive state cases; real registry/filesystem fixtures cover interruption at each serialized publication boundary, unchanged integrity and refusal of conflicting bytes. Workflow graph tests require every native install/upgrade/walk/audit before sealing and exact artifact consumption before publication. Native channel checks launch the same packages, test running installer/Homebrew upgrades and restart after old-keg deletion. Serialization removes overlapping publishers; immutable version/commit/digest checks refuse other owners. Hosted token/ruleset/registry/tap operation and the RC rehearsal remain platform acceptance, not claims from a model.
